'''Chesla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] settler on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. She lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], and when the city was struck by a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]] in [[3643 BBY]], the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Galen Besk]] believed that she would make it to safety herself.
